>
[Healer's Toolkit](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2727)
</title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 288

**Price** 5 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Hands** -1

**Bulk** 1
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This kit of bandages, herbs, and suturing tools is necessary for [Medicine](/Skills.aspx?ID=9) checks to [Administer First Aid](/Actions.aspx?ID=54), [Treat Disease](/Actions.aspx?ID=55), [Treat Poison](/Actions.aspx?ID=56), or [Treat Wounds](/Actions.aspx?ID=57). If you wear your healer's toolkit, you can draw and replace them as part of the action that uses them.
